label: Недавно
description: A 10-sentence usage card for недавно (recently, not long ago).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Recent past. 'Недавно' places the action in the near past, modifying the perfective 'прочитал'. It pairs naturally with past-tense verbs to mean not long ago.
Strategic focus: A recent change. 'Недавно' marks a move that happened a short time ago, modifying 'переехали'. The neutral register suits everyday conversation.
Strategic focus: Asking about the near past. In a question 'недавно' asks whether something happened lately. It modifies 'видел', and the word order keeps the tone casual.
Strategic focus: Fronted recency. Placed first, 'недавно' sets the time frame before the event, modifying 'прошёл'. The sentence reports a recent weather occurrence.
Strategic focus: Very recently. 'Только недавно' tightens the time frame to the immediate past, modifying 'узнал'. The 'только' stresses how little time has passed.
Strategic focus: Emphasized recency. 'Совсем недавно' means only very recently, modifying 'познакомились'. The intensifier 'совсем' underlines that the acquaintance is fresh.
Strategic focus: Recent beginning. 'Недавно' frames the start of an ongoing activity, modifying 'начал'. It signals that the learning is a fairly new undertaking.
Strategic focus: Recent return. 'Недавно' places the return in the near past, modifying 'вернулась'. The phrase is a natural way to report a fresh arrival home.
Strategic focus: Newly happened. End-position 'недавно' modifies 'открылся', telling when the shop opened. The placement gives the recency a light end-of-sentence stress.
Strategic focus: Recent experience. 'Недавно' opens the sentence to set the near-past time, modifying 'приснился'. It introduces a recent and personal event.
